name: Deep research (Chinese prompt): tumor immunotherapy survey with ledger-rendered citations
title_en: Deep research — tumor immunotherapy survey driven by a Chinese prompt
title_zh: 深度研究——中文提问的肿瘤免疫治疗文献综述
summary_en: Same deep-research skill, Chinese-language request (the connector's canonical zh example): parallel workers build per-aspect evidence ledgers, the render script numbers every cite-key marker and generates the References section, and vet-references.py audits the result - the agent answers and reports in Chinese while querying English biomedical sources, citing PMIDs.
summary_zh: 同一深度研究技能，中文提问（WorkBuddy 连接器的中文示例语料）：并行工作节点构建逐方面证据账本，render 脚本统一为引用键编号并生成参考文献，vet-references.py 审计结果——智能体检索英文生物医学数据源，以中文撰写综述并附 PMID 引用。
purpose: Bilingual evidence: deep-research skill with a zh prompt; asserts the ledger citation pipeline, PMID citations and Chinese final text.
prompt: no-interview light-research: 使用 bioresearcher-deep-research 技能，帮我做一个关于肿瘤免疫治疗（tumor immunotherapy）的文献综述并附引用。最多 2 个研究方面，每个方面的工作节点最多调用 10 次 biomcp 工具。请用中文撰写报告，引用使用 PMID。

checks.desc: parallel worker dispatch (Tier A/B) is mandatory when a subagent tool exists (deep-research 1.7.0 Step 4)
tier-independent literature proof: ledger keys (add echo / check stdout) contain line-start pmid: entries - live dispatch runs keep article_search inside worker streams, invisible to the parent log
render verb success banner: the numbering authority generated the citations + References section (FAILED banners must not match)
the Step 5c offline structural audit passed: contiguous [1]..[N], N == bibliography count, zero placeholders
final answer must contain Chinese text (zh prompt => zh report)
HTML rendering is default-on; a successful conversion rung must surface final_report.html in tool output

checks.flag: verify-citation-pipeline-artifacts (inspect reports/<TOPIC>/final_report.draft.md, final_report.md and evidence/sources.jsonl): (a) the draft still contains [@key] cite-key markers - proof it was authored key-based, never hand-numbered; (b) the References section is ledger-generated Vancouver style (consistent author initials, journal, year, PMID/DOI per entry); (c) in-text citations are contiguous [1]..[N] numbered by order of first appearance.
